```{r}

# Load in Packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)

# Read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level

ej <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"))

# Filter to a state

nebraska <- ej |> 
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "NE")


# Filter to a county 

douglas <- nebraska |> 
    dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME == "Douglas County")


# Find the average values for all variables within counties

ne_counties <- aggregate(nebraska, by = list(nebraska$CNTY_NAME), FUN = mean)

```


```{r}

# Cleaning data so we do not have NA columns in the interactive map

clean_ne <- ne_counties |> 
    select(-c("ID", "STATE_NAME", "ST_ABBREV", "CNTY_NAME"))


```


```{r}

# make the map output interactive
tmap_mode("plot")

```

```{r}

tm_shape(clean_ne) + 
    tm_polygons(fill = "LOWINCPCT",
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percentage of Low Income Community"),
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "-viridis")) +
    tm_bubbles(fill = "PRE1960PCT", 
    size = 1.0,
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percentage of Houses Built Before 1960"),
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = c("lightblue", "darkblue")))


```


```{r}

tm_shape(clean_ne) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "LOWINCPCT",
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "Blues"),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Percentage of Low Income Community")) + 
    tm_bubbles(fill = "PM25", size = 1.0,
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Particulate Matter (PM2.5)"),
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = c("yellow", "red")))


```
